code_release_commitment: The generation code (adapted generator, answer verifier, label-review tools) will be made available to reviewers with the paper's submission and published on GitHub together with the paper.
rights_note: Licences are given as declared by each source's publisher (or, for Amazon Reviews 2023, as permitted by its authors). The underlying rights of the original writers (reviewers, patients, thesis authors, news sites) were not independently established. A licence does not grant permission to process personal data.

musteri_tr.licence_declared_by: the dataset's publisher on the Hugging Face Hub (Turkish NLP Suite); the reviews were collected from public shopping and film sites

sinema_tr.licence_declared_by: the dataset's publisher on the Hugging Face Hub (Turkish NLP Suite); the reviews were collected from public shopping and film sites

vitamins_tr.licence_declared_by: the dataset's publisher on the Hugging Face Hub (Turkish NLP Suite); the reviews were collected from public shopping and film sites

amazon_hpc_en.selection: every review with a rating (the whole category)
amazon_hpc_en.permission_given_by: the dataset's authors (McAuley Lab, UC San Diego) agreed by email on 18 October 2026 that TR-OOLONG may release the review text, as described in this card, with attribution, a link to the dataset and a citation; this permission covers this release and implies no licence for further reuse; no licence is declared on the dataset card

amazon_movies_en.selection: 1 in 16 reviews by SHA-256 of the review text; at least 15 words; no mention of the disc, delivery or seller
amazon_movies_en.permission_given_by: the dataset's authors (McAuley Lab, UC San Diego) agreed by email on 18 October 2026 that TR-OOLONG may release the review text, as described in this card, with attribution, a link to the dataset and a citation; this permission covers this release and implies no licence for further reuse; no licence is declared on the dataset card

amazon_shop_en.selection: per category, the lines with SHA-256(raw line) % K == 0 (K = file size / 470 bytes / 120,000: 401, 557, 493, 195, 166, 130); 3-37 words
amazon_shop_en.permission_given_by: the dataset's authors (McAuley Lab, UC San Diego) agreed by email on 18 October 2026 that TR-OOLONG may release the review text, as described in this card, with attribution, a link to the dataset and a citation; this permission covers this release and implies no licence for further reuse; no licence is declared on the dataset card

doktor_tr.licence_declared_by: the dataset's publisher on the Hugging Face Hub; the questions were written by users of doktorsitesi.com
doktor_tr.personal_data: known-name patterns removed (doctors' names next to a form of address or title replaced, other listed first names removed); questions with an e-mail address or a self-introduction dropped; residual identifiers and linkable health narratives may remain (CONSTRUCTION.md)
doktor_tr.labels: routing specialties (the specialty of the doctor the question was addressed to), not clinical diagnoses

tez.licence_declared_by: the dataset's publisher on the Hugging Face Hub; the abstracts are written by the thesis authors and published by YÖK (National Thesis Center)

trnews2025_tr.licence_declared_by: the dataset's uploader on Kaggle (sengulbayrak; version 1, created 2 April 2026); the page says the articles were gathered from Turkish online newspapers and portals with students of a natural-language-processing course at Istanbul Sabahattin Zaim University, names no source sites and makes no statement about the sites' copyright (checked through the Kaggle API on 21 October 2026)

wikinews_en.licence: public domain (before 25 September 2005), CC-BY-2.5 (25 September 2005 to 15 December 2024), CC-BY-4.0 (from 16 December 2024); each article's title and URL are in attribution/wikinews_en.jsonl

partition: Each cleaned source is split 10% development / 90% test by a SHA-256 hash of its normalised text; exact duplicates (and, for MASSIVE, an utterance and its translation) always fall on the same side. No record is in both splits.

tokenizer.name: Qwen/Qwen3-8B
tokenizer.use: document sizing and the n_tokens field only; the revision is pinned in the build code

seeds: Every random choice of a document is seeded from a SHA-256 of its identifiers (source, split, length or record count, margin, document index, and for the main set the redraw number `attempt`). Each document records its `seed`; the main set also records the label-mix `temperature`. Rebuilding gives byte-identical files.
generator: Documents and questions were built with an adapted version of the OOLONG-synth generator (Bertsch et al., 2025, MIT licence), with Turkish record lines and question templates. The adapted code is released with the paper.
verification: recompute_answers.py recomputes every answer from the labelled records of every set. It checks arithmetic and translations of answers, not whether a source label is right.
